title: Text: DET Sam Menzin ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: What do you think of the Mets hiring Brodie Van Wagonen as GM?
He’s charismatic for sure. Text me tomorrow about it

I’m not going to care about it tomorrow. Nightengale’s column stirred me up. It’s a clown show, typical Mets, spitting in the face of more qualified candidates, opening a box that shouldn’t be opened.
Because a lot of agents’ ears have perked up, I’m sure. And he very well could succeed - it’s not rocket science - but I’m just wholly against the precedent that’s been set.
I’m also a curmudgeon. He proved his worth as an agent, though: He totally sold himself, like he would one of his clients. Good for him.
It’s 3:30 am in Malta, I’ve been overserved, and I’m getting a cab home. Thanks for getting back to me. See you in San Diego.
Haha sounds good man. Happy to listen to your rant anytime.
